auditor: Principal Data Quality Auditor & Independent ML Evaluation Auditor

category_A_gold_standard_core.name: Legacy Core Anchor Dataset
category_A_gold_standard_core.description: Original human-annotated resume-job fit pairs from Phase 1-12

category_B_djinni_proposed_sample.name: Djinni Stratified Candidate-Pair Proposals
category_B_djinni_proposed_sample.description: Candidate pairs sampled from Djinni English data across High Alignment, Borderline Runner-Up, and Cross-Domain strata

category_C_djinni_unlabeled_inventory.name: Djinni Full Unpaired Inventory
category_C_djinni_unlabeled_inventory.description: Raw candidate profiles and job postings downloaded from Hugging Face
category_C_djinni_unlabeled_inventory.use_policy: Permitted ONLY for unsupervised pre-training, vocabulary extraction, and stratified pair sampling. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN from supervised training without human adjudication.

supervised_dataset_integrity_rules.rule_1: Category B (830 proposed pairs) is NEVER merged into supervised training sets until human annotation and adjudication are 100% complete.
supervised_dataset_integrity_rules.rule_2: Category C (352k unpaired inventory) is NEVER auto-labelled via heuristics, similarity thresholds, or synthetic LLMs.
supervised_dataset_integrity_rules.rule_3: The 1,759 held-out test pairs in Category A remain strictly frozen and untouched.
supervised_dataset_integrity_rules.rule_4: No claim of an expanded labelled dataset (e.g. 15,000 pairs) is made until physical human annotations exist on disk.
